It is environment-sensitive (frame timing on a loaded machine) and is UNRESOLVED: the threshold was deliberately not raised without evidence. securityPosture.note: Re-derived from the migrations on 2026-09-19..20, not from the advisor summary alone. Design is sound; the gap is test coverage.
securityPosture.advisorDiscrepancy: The Supabase advisor reports 24 authenticated SECURITY DEFINER functions. The true figure is 23; the advisor counts the 4 anon RFQ functions, which are granted to both anon and authenticated, against a set that also includes them.
openFindings: P2 (needs an owner decision): a buyer can now re-point orders.approved_plan_id between the proposed variants of their own request (migration 0051). ensure_order_supplier_threads_on_plan_change inserts supplier threads on every pointer change and never removes them, and threads_select_own_supplier lets a supplier owner read a thread without the plan-membership predicate. Sequence A -> B -> A therefore leaves supplier B a permanent thread on an order it is not on. The reachable set is only supplier companies staff already placed on a plan of that buyer's own request, and the accumulate-never-remove behaviour is pre-existing (propose_order_plans and resolve_plan_change also move the pointer); 0051 lets a buyer drive it at will. Options: accept and document, or gate thread creation on plan approval. Mechanism CONFIRMED from the trigger and policy bodies; NOT REPRODUCED.

P3: variant switching leaves no audit row. audit_order_stage_transition returns early when OLD.state = NEW.state and select_order_plan writes to no history table, so "which variant did the buyer pick, and when" has no row of its own. Fix belongs in a new additive migration on the RPC.

P3 (hypothesis): the guard reads plans.status without a lock on the direct-PATCH path. If staff supersede the target plan concurrently, the order can end up pointing at a superseded plan and approve_plan then refuses it. The RPC path is safe (orders FOR UPDATE, then plans FOR UPDATE, same order as approve_plan). Not reproduced; not a privilege escalation.

P3: is_staff_user(uuid) lets any signed-in user ask whether an arbitrary UUID belongs to QAJET staff. RLS policies need it for other users' ids and SECURITY DEFINER is what lets it read users past RLS; exploiting it requires already knowing the UUID. Recorded in docs/security/security-definer-inventory.md. Accept, or restrict to callers who already share an order or thread with the target.

P1 (UX/workflow, REPRODUCED, product decision pending): a supplier can submit a quote without the "can fulfil" checkbox; it succeeds silently, the concierge then sees "all quotes rejected" and cannot propose a plan, and the board row looks like a healthy order. Options and recommendation in docs/qa/post-hardening-ux-audit.md F1.

P1 (product decision, ASSUMPTION about the platform): if the Vercel function body limit of about 4.5 MB applies, attachments between ~4.5 and 10 MB fail in production even after the Server Action limit fix. Options: upload straight to Storage with a signed upload URL (removes the limit and the function from the path, larger change) or state an honest lower limit in the form (small change). Verify the actual limit on the deployed project before choosing.

defectsFixed.status: FIXED in migration 0051 (local only); NOT applied to production
defectsFixed.summary: The buyer button "choose another variant" (apps/web/app/buyer/orders/[id]/_plan-alternatives.tsx -> selectPlan -> select_order_plan) always failed. The guard refuses with RAISE EXCEPTION (SQLSTATE P0001), which actionFailure classifies as a business rejection, so the buyer saw the internal sentence "Покупатель не может менять внутренние поля заказа" with NO supportId. (An earlier version of this note said a generic error with a supportId; that was wrong, corrected 2026-09-20 after reading action-result.ts.) The message is confusing and, having no code, could not be found through the support-id runbook.
defectsFixed.cause: select_order_plan (0037) updates orders.approved_plan_id for the buyer, but guard_order_actor allowed a buyer to change only state and closing fields in every version from 0020 to 0041. Inside a SECURITY DEFINER function current_setting(role) is still authenticated, so the guard saw a direct buyer edit and raised "Покупатель не может менять внутренние поля заказа". Only the EXECUTE grant was ever tested, never a buyer actually calling it.
defectsFixed.evidence: REPRODUCED by privileged-rpc-authorization.test.ts against real PostgreSQL: RED (2 of 42 failed) before the migration, GREEN after. Five of six guard conditions are mutation-checked; the sixth (v_buyer inside v_repoint) is an equivalent mutant.
defectsFixed.fix: The invariant now lives in guard_order_actor: a buyer may change approved_plan_id only before approval, to a proposed plan of the same request, in the same stage, with no other column changed. A session-flag design (like qajet.stage_reason) was rejected because it would be a forgeable privilege.
defectsFixed.review: Independent read-only Opus review (database-reviewer): SAFE WITH CHANGES. Delta confirmed exact, no accidental edits, ACL preserved (anon and authenticated still cannot execute the trigger function), no reachable escalation found. Its required changes were to the tests and are done: fixture now has real plan lines, the concierge case and the supplier visibility flip are pinned, branch tests added, exception swallowing removed, a dead NOT NULL condition dropped.

defectsFixed.summary: A file with a Cyrillic name never uploaded: Storage answers "Invalid key" for non-ASCII object keys and the key was built from the file name with \p{L}. For a Russian-language product this is the ordinary case.
defectsFixed.evidence: REPRODUCED directly against local Storage and through the UI. adapter.test.ts was RED 10 of 16 (all Cyrillic, Kazakh, quote and long-name cases, ASCII controls green), now 18 of 18. Download name: supabase-js double-encodes the download option, so the name is appended once on the signed URL; verified end to end in storage-flow.spec.ts. NOT verified on production Storage.

defectsFixed.status: FIXED in code (next.config.ts serverActions.bodySizeLimit 11mb, client size check); not deployed; PARTIAL on Vercel
defectsFixed.summary: A valid 2 MB attachment vanished with no error: Server Actions accept 1 MB by default while the UI promises 10 MB; the server logged 413 and the user saw nothing.
defectsFixed.evidence: REPRODUCED through the UI. The 2 MB upload test was RED against the unfixed build and is green after. ASSUMPTION, not verified: Vercel limits a function request body to about 4.5 MB regardless of Next configuration, so files between roughly 4.5 and 10 MB probably still fail in production, silently. See the open finding below.

externalRequirements: Apply migrations 0051_buyer_plan_repoint and 0052_trigger_function_privileges to production Supabase (eoqcktgvnzayyinulbch) after this branch is merged. Both are additive (a CREATE OR REPLACE of guard_order_actor, and a REVOKE loop over trigger functions), compatible with the deployed app in either order. Nothing in this branch has touched production.
Set SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in Vercel production. /api/ready checks exactly three variables and the database is ACTIVE_HEALTHY, so this alone should return it to 200.
Set CRON_SECRET in both Vercel production and GitHub Actions repository secrets, with the same value in both, or the workflow bearer token will not match.
Set RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_FROM_EMAIL in Vercel production, and fix the silent local-sink fallback so a missing key can never report delivery.
Enable leaked-password protection in Supabase Auth.
A tested backup and restore procedure for database, Auth and private files.
A Kazakhstan data-residency decision before any real personal data is used.
A real pilot company, supplier and bank-transfer operator.
Run the manual strict release gate (release.yml, strict=true, ready_url=<deployment>) once /api/ready returns 200.
